notes.title: A Winding Path out now on Nintendo Switch!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38406466/682899ac451b341fed93cd3861483b9628d961e3.gif[/img]

[i]A Winding Path[/i] was released on Nintendo Switch today! We're super excited and we certainly didn't think this would happen when the three of us started on this game in 2020, so thank you all, sincerely! To celebrate the release, the game is 20% off for a week on the Nintendo eStore. Get it now, and let us know how you like the game ːsteamhappyː A Steam discount will follow in a few days.

► https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/a-winding-path-switch/

The Switch release also comes with a thorough [b]Spanish translation[/b] that our wonderful publisher Flynn's Arcade made possible. We will port it over to Steam as soon as we can, so you can enjoy the game in Spanish here as well.

Thank you all for sharing this journey with us! <3
– Christian, Flo and David

notes.title: What's new in Build 154
notes.notes:
Here's what's new in A Winding Path:

[list]
[*]Added three new color presets [i]Adrift in Dreams[/i], [i]Let them eat Cake![/i] and [i]That special T-Shirt.[/i]
[*] Improved community accessibility via main and pause menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Autumn is here, sit back and relax!
notes.notes:
[i]When all trees lose their greenish dress,
Leaves fall and make a colorful mess.
When rain is pouring from the sky,
A fire keeps us warm and dry.
When nights come early, air gets icy,
We have some tea or soup that’s spicy.
When cyclopes swap their bow for rake,
Drink Guil’haven Ale and catch a break![/i]

Sip a cup of tea or hot chocolate while you play with our new point-and-click mouse controls. Click anywhere near the ground to move there or on yourself to interact at your position. The magical lyre can also be controlled with the mouse: just click and drag to play a note depending on the direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38406466/e967b028d963ae6b7c603a7c8dd67ddec4fcde1a.gif[/img]

Inspired by the many-colored leaves that are falling from the trees these days, we added color modes to the game. “Nightfall” is perfect for playing in the evening, and there are more presets that allow you to experience the game in a new way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38406466/496c9103d65a008ef6492137ae827a8b632171c1.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy this update. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/9dP4Bqb]Discord[/url] and let us know your thoughts!

[i]Christian, Flo and David
Three Eyed Games[/i]

notes.title: Invitation to the Competition of Fine Archery
notes.notes:
Respected Sir or Madam,

The [i]Cyclopean Archery Association[/i] would like to cordially invite you to the [i]Competition of Fine Archery[/i]. If you feel inclined to nock an arrow and show your skill, join us at the beautiful [i]Artemis Archery Club[/i] just outside the city of [i]Guildhaven[/i] in this test of aim, speed and perseverance. Together, let us celebrate this sophisticated sport and friendly rivalry!

And remember:
[i]No matter the number of eyes,
Every archer gets ten tries![/i]

With best wishes,
[i]Osonia Beifaren
President of the Cyclopean Archery Association[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38406466/8841aa326e910e8de4d1d7d3a6cba6d404157fc3.gif[/img]

To enter the competition, head back to the Artemis Archery Club at the end of the game. You can also load a previous, finished playthrough.

Upon closer inspection, you will find that the following improvements have been made:
[list]
[*] The [i]Competition of Fine Archery[/i] is held at the Artemis Archery Club.
[*] Leaderboards show you the best times for 8, 9 and 10 targets hit, respectively.
[*] The [i]Competition of Fine Archery[/i] comes with a brand new set of 5 achievements.
[*] A round of [i]Fine Archery[/i] can be canceled with the pause menu button.
[*] Starting with a fresh set of arrows has never been easier: Just pick up the bow again!
[*] The keenest eyes might find additional small changes and improvements.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update. Please join us on [url=https://discord.gg/9dP4Bqb]Discord[/url] and let us know!

notes.title: A Winding Path – out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38406466/b9a64ecb42c8fbd2aeaadf6f0efb5e0d4ad710c6.png[/img]
We are proud to announce that
[b]A Winding Path is now available![/b]

It all started with something simple: A doodle of a farm with bubbly ground and a windmill. When we first saw it come to life, we fell in love with the cute little world that it was. Soon, the farm turned into a village and it moved next to a mountain. A fishing village appeared, right next to an old forest. The world kept growing and so did the stories within – stories from a place full of lighthearted positivity and wholesome little encounters.

Looking back, it becomes clear that we wouldn't have made it without the support of our families and friends. Thank you to all of you wonderful people!

And now it is time for you to go and find beauty in the world and enjoy the little things.
We hope you enjoy the journey!

[i]Christian, Flo and David
Three Eyed Games[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38406466/fd80b8eae82afce494880b7c6dfccedf78870f8c.png[/img]
